Next Gen · SOJO Kids · Birth – 5th Grade · Sundays 9 & 11am

Your kids are
the first thing
we think about

Safe, joyful, age-specific rooms during both services — so you can actually be present in yours.

KnowLong before your child can define any of this, she can know she is safe, loved, and wanted. That is where knowing Life starts.

Pre-register your kids All of Next Gen

Why parents relax here

Four promises
we keep

01

Every volunteer is background-checked

Screened, trained, and never alone with a child. No exceptions, no shortcuts, no “we've known them forever” workarounds.

02

Only you can pick them up

Secure electronic check-in gives you a matching tag. No tag, no child. It's the least romantic thing about Sunday and the part we're most rigid about.

03

They'll want to come back

Kids who like church make Sunday easier on everybody. Ours is loud in the right places and warm in all of them.

04

You get to worship

That's the point of all of it. Your kid is cared for, so you get 75 uninterrupted minutes with God and other adults.

The rooms

Built for
their age

Nursery · 0–24 months

Loving, attentive volunteers in a calm, secure room. Comfort, care, and prayer over your little one. A home away from home.

Preschool · 2–4 years

Hands-on activities, interactive Bible stories, worship and play — built to match their energy, curiosity, and growing independence.

Elementary · K–5th

High-energy worship, engaging teaching, and small groups where they build real friendships and start owning their own faith.

At Gibson Mill, our nursery is just off the café area to your left as you come through the main doors. Kids 4 and up meet in the main kids space next door to the worship room. For everyone's comfort, that environment is for fully potty-trained kids.

Jillian Goodhew · SOJO Kids Director

Meet the director

Jillian
Goodhew

The heartbeat of SOJO Kids.

Jillian is relentless about one thing: that every child who walks through those doors feels known, loved, and excited to come back. She builds the environments, trains the leaders, and keeps the standard high — because your kids are worth it.

Got a question about allergies, special needs, check-in, or anything else? Ask her directly.

Call or text us

When they age out

It keeps going
to thirty

After 5th grade comes SOJO YTH — 6th through 12th grade, Wednesdays 6–8pm. After that, SOJO YA for ages 18 to 30, Fridays 6–8pm with dinner at 8.

The handoffs between environments are where most churches quietly lose people. We watch those on purpose.
